differentials.title: How I work
differentials.intro1: My practice is guided by strategic analysis, risk assessment and informed decision-making. Before any judicial or extrajudicial measure, I evaluate legal viability, financial impact and available alternatives, advising the client clearly and responsibly.
differentials.intro2: I use legal technology as a tool for organisation, analysis and efficiency, combined with a multidisciplinary background that allows me to understand each case beyond the process, considering contractual, economic and strategic aspects. I work in a rigorous manner, prioritising legally sound solutions and avoiding claims without technical basis.
differentials.riskAnalysisDesc: Legal practice guided by risk analysis, considering legal viability, financial impact and strategic alternatives before taking any measure.
differentials.strategicVisionDesc: Understanding litigation as part of a broader strategy, not as an end in itself.
differentials.techIntegrationDesc: Responsible use of legal technology for organisation, data analysis, routine standardisation and decision support.
differentials.multidisciplinaryDesc: Integration of legal, economic and strategic knowledge for a more complete analysis of cases and contracts.
differentials.selectiveDesc: Rigorous practice, with case acceptance conditional on prior assessment of legal viability.
